situations.title: GI 출혈 징후 사정
situations.tagline: I just threw up something that looked like coffee grounds.
situations.brief: 토혈과 혈변, 활력징후를 사정해 소화관 출혈의 정도를 파악하세요.
keyPhrases: That can be a sign of bleeding, so I'm checking you closely.
I'm going to take your vitals and look at your color.
Tell me right away if you feel dizzy or want to vomit again.

situations.title: 대구경 정맥로 확보 협조
situations.tagline: Let's get two large-bore IVs in before he drops any further.
situations.brief: 소생을 위해 대구경 정맥로를 신속히 확보하도록 협력하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll grab two large-bore catheters and the fluids.
You take the right arm, I'll take the left.
Let's have blood tubes ready to draw at the same time.

situations.title: 수혈 준비·교차시험
situations.tagline: Can you send a type and cross and set up for possible transfusion?
situations.brief: 교차시험을 보내고 수혈을 신속히 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Type and cross is drawn and sent to the blood bank.
I'll get the transfusion tubing and warmer ready.
Let's confirm consent and the armband now.

situations.title: 혈역학·Hb 추세 감시
situations.tagline: I feel so dizzy and weak — is that from losing blood?
situations.brief: 활력징후와 헤모글로빈 추세를 감시해 실혈 정도를 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: Yes, that can happen when the blood count drops.
I'm watching your blood pressure and your lab trends.
Please stay lying down so you don't get lightheaded.

situations.title: NPO·위관 관리
situations.tagline: Why do I need this tube down my nose and nothing to eat?
situations.brief: 금식과 위관 감압의 목적을 설명하고 평가에 대비하세요.
keyPhrases: The tube helps us empty and check your stomach.
We keep you from eating until it's safe.
This helps the doctors see if the bleeding has stopped.

situations.title: 출혈 병력·항응고 검토
situations.tagline: I take a blood thinner every day — could that be why I'm bleeding?
situations.brief: 출혈 병력과 항응고제 사용 등 위험인자를 검토하세요.
keyPhrases: That's important to know, and it can affect bleeding.
Which blood thinner do you take, and when was your last dose?
I'll make sure the team knows all your medications.

situations.title: 정맥류 출혈 초기 관리
situations.tagline: This looks like a variceal bleed — do you want octreotide and antibiotics started?
situations.brief: 정맥류 출혈에 혈관수축제와 예방 항생제를 신속히 시작하세요.
keyPhrases: Yes, let's start the octreotide drip now.
I'll give the prophylactic antibiotic as ordered.
Keep her airway protected while we stabilize.

situations.title: 내시경 준비·조율
situations.tagline: GI is on the way for a scope — can we get him stable and consented?
situations.brief: 내시경 시술 전 환자를 안정화하고 동의와 준비를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm his airway and hemodynamics first.
I'll get consent and the pre-procedure checklist done.
Blood is on standby if we need it during the scope.

situations.title: 제한적 수혈 목표 판단
situations.tagline: His hemoglobin is 7.2 — are we holding to the restrictive transfusion threshold?
situations.brief: 제한적 수혈 전략에 따라 수혈 시점을 판단하고 협력하세요.
keyPhrases: For a stable bleed, we usually hold to the restrictive target.
Let's reassess if he shows signs of ongoing bleeding.
I'll recheck the hemoglobin and his symptoms.
goals: 제한적 수혈 목표에 따라 수혈 시점을 판단한다

situations.title: PPI 주입 관리
situations.tagline: Let's get the PPI drip running for this upper GI bleed.
situations.brief: 상부 출혈에서 PPI 지속주입을 관리하고 반응을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: The PPI infusion is started at the ordered rate.
I'll monitor for rebleeding and his vitals.
Let's keep him NPO while the drip runs.

situations.title: 응고장애 교정
situations.tagline: His INR is high and platelets are low — should we correct before the scope?
situations.brief: INR와 혈소판 등 응고장애를 시술 전 교정하도록 협력하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's give the plasma and platelets as ordered.
I'll recheck the coags after correction.
We want him corrected before the procedure.

situations.title: balloon tamponade 보조
situations.tagline: The bleeding won't stop — help me set up the balloon tamponade tube.
situations.brief: 정맥류 응급에서 balloon tamponade 삽입을 안전하게 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll test the balloons and gather the supplies.
His airway is secured before we insert it.
Let's mark the traction and monitor closely.
goals: balloon tamponade 삽입 준비와 보조를 수행한다

situations.title: 하부출혈 감별·검사
situations.tagline: There's bright red blood in the toilet — where is it coming from?
situations.brief: 하부 출혈의 원인을 감별하기 위한 검사 접근을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Bright red blood usually points to lower down in the gut.
We'll do tests to find exactly where it's coming from.
I'm watching your vitals while we sort this out.
goals: 하부 출혈 감별을 위한 검사 접근을 설명한다

situations.title: 재출혈 감시·재평가
situations.tagline: He was doing better — how will you know if he starts bleeding again?
situations.brief: 재출혈 징후를 감시하고 안정성을 반복 재평가하세요.
keyPhrases: We watch his vitals, labs, and any new bleeding closely.
Please tell me if he vomits blood or feels faint.
We'll recheck his blood count regularly.

situations.title: IR·내시경 이송 조율
situations.tagline: IR can embolize him — let's coordinate the handoff and transport.
situations.brief: IR 시술을 위해 안전한 이송과 인계를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll prep him and confirm IR is ready to receive.
Let's bring blood and emergency meds for transport.
I'll give a clear handoff of his bleeding and vitals.
goals: IR 시술을 위한 안전 이송을 준비한다

situations.title: 대량출혈 쇼크 대량수혈
situations.tagline: He's in hemorrhagic shock — I'm activating the massive transfusion protocol.
situations.brief: 대량출혈 쇼크에서 대량수혈 프로토콜을 발동해 신속히 소생하세요.
keyPhrases: Activate MTP and get the cooler now.
Let's transfuse in balanced ratios and warm the blood.
Keep the pressure up and recheck his labs frequently.

situations.title: 토혈 기도흡인 위기
situations.tagline: There's so much blood coming up — he's choking, please help him!
situations.brief: 대량 토혈에서 기도 흡인을 막으며 흡인과 삽관을 신속히 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: We're turning him on his side to protect his airway.
I'm suctioning now and the team is coming to help.
I'll stay right here with him.
goals: 기도 흡인을 막도록 체위와 흡인을 즉시 시행한다

situations.title: 정맥류 불응 출혈 위기
situations.tagline: The varices won't hold — IR is prepping for an emergent TIPS.
situations.brief: 불응성 정맥류 출혈에서 TIPS를 위해 신속히 소통하고 협력하세요.
keyPhrases: Keep the tamponade and drips running until IR takes him.
I'll give a full handoff and bring blood along.
Let's stabilize his pressure for transport.
goals: 불응성 정맥류 출혈에서 TIPS로 신속히 연계한다

situations.title: 재출혈 급변 소생
situations.tagline: He just started bleeding heavily again — his pressure's crashing, help now!
situations.brief: 재출혈로 급변한 환자를 즉각 소생하고 팀과 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Open the fluids wide and call for blood now.
I'm notifying GI and the physician immediately.
Let's reassess his airway and vitals.
goals: 재출혈 급변에 즉각 소생 조치를 취한다

situations.title: 응고장애 동반 지속출혈
situations.tagline: He keeps oozing everywhere — the coags are a mess, we need to balance the products.
situations.brief: 응고장애를 동반한 지속 출혈에서 성분수혈 균형을 맞추며 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's give plasma, platelets, and cryo in balance.
Recheck the coags and fibrinogen frequently.
Keep him warm to help his clotting.
goals: 성분수혈을 균형 있게 투여해 응고를 회복한다

situations.title: 출혈 불응 목표·예후 소통
situations.tagline: His liver is failing and the bleeding won't stop — what are we even fighting for now?
situations.brief: 간질환 맥락에서 불응성 출혈의 예후와 치료 목표를 가족과 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: The bleeding is very hard to control with his liver disease.
I want to be honest with you about what we're facing.
Let's talk about what matters most for him now.
goals: 치료 목표 논의를 가족과 함께 진행한다
